name: Blue Hills Farm Carriere
tagline: Link to Blue Hills Farm Carriere Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/Jimbeaux1970/
description: In 259 Joe Smith Rd, MS, Blue Hills Farm Carriere raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Check the website for current hours and availability.
